d: In this interview with Rajeev Masand, mathematician and educator Anand Kumar talks about Super 30, the biopic that’s been made on his life. He explains why Hrithik Roshan was the best actor to play him despite no physical resemblance, weighs in on the allegations of sexual harassment leveled against the film’s director Vikas Bahl, and responds to the many accusations denouncing his supposedly successful Super 30 program for IIT-JEE aspirants. This interview first aired on CNN News18 on June 19, 2019.
